verdict.rationale: Oyster is an HR/EOR SaaS platform that holds sensitive employee data, so an AI-training opt-out or data-usage restriction is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers APIs, webhooks, sandboxes, payroll and onboarding, but says nothing about AI training data use or any opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
